_meta.purpose: Structured equipment catalog for LIFT machine-aware logging. The app reads a machine's convention + scale_tag so logging is handled automatically when Travis picks the station. Pairs with exercise-library.json.
_meta.owner: coaching chat (this file). Mirrors the prose gym-equipment.md; this is the machine-readable version.

convention_legend.per_side: Plate-loaded — log ONE side's plate weight, exclude bar.
convention_legend.as_marked: Selectorized stack / DB / fixed bar — log marked/total.

_meta.scale_rule: TAG & STORE, never auto-convert. Each scale_tag is its own track. A number difference across tags is NOT a strength change. Cable scales currently in building: hoist_cmj (~1:1), versa (1:2), matrix_g3ms53 (UNKNOWN). Confirm matrix ratio before bridging.
